page.overview:
Who is Tosa?

Tosa is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

He serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

Tosa is a big burly dark skinned man with a big roundish black beard. He has huge hairy muscular arms and big hands. He wears a cap with the word "MARINES" on, as well an orange t-shirt, dark green pants, dark boots. As a high-ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders with golden cuffs.

Tosa takes missions seriously. He was confident that with his abilities he could take down Jewelry Bonney. He also showed concern for Jaygarcia Saturn when Bonney stabbed the Elder.
